concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Retain concept wavy steep aligned flaky foliation with broad coherent mass. Remove photoreal grain and repeated equal plate thickness; use unequal foliation-controlled ledges and localized small folds across visible front and back. Physical continuous surface relief, no disconnected overlapping flakes or coplanar slabs. Predominantly same gray mineral family with subdued mica facets, not alternating dark pale coarse gneiss bands. Irregular top and sides, no rectangle plinth. NPS claim oldest-world not adopted. Source ranger and vegetation omitted.
